e74d4ad1214e3bd5.invariant: RECONSTRUCT-DON'T-HOLD (the stateless/stateful bridge): the SYSTEM is stateless (workers and queries spawn cold and die, re-deriving from content-addressed source), but our KNOWLEDGE of it is stateful (the chain/RIBs/corpus accumulate and persist as the wave). Query = RECONSTRUCT the answer from the source bytes every time — never read a held snapshot that can drift. Stateless water, stateful wave, reconstructed on demand: the system can't be captured (nothing held) and the knowledge can't lie (it IS the current bytes, with provenance).
